articles.headline: US and Iran trade strikes across the Gulf
articles.source: Reuters, via Just Security and Drop Site
articles.summary: US jets hit an Iranian missile site as Iran targets bases in Kuwait and Bahrain.

articles.headline: Peltola beats Sullivan in Alaska Senate race
articles.source: Associated Press, via Just Security and Democracy Now
articles.summary: Democrat Mary Peltola defeats the incumbent, lifting the Democratic Senate total to 56.

articles.headline: Xi greets Trump in Shenzhen at APEC summit
articles.source: Axios and Reuters, via Just Security
articles.summary: Xi met Trump on the tarmac; a three-way meeting with Putin is expected.

articles.headline: NSA network outage adds to string of US disruptions
articles.source: Washington Post, via Drop Site and Democracy Now
articles.summary: The NSA's classified network was down; officials say no sign of a cyberattack.

articles.headline: OpenAI releases GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol
articles.source: OpenAI, via The Neuron and Tech Trends News Update
articles.summary: Two new models target hard technical work and everyday agent tasks.

articles.headline: Microsoft unveils MAI models and agent tools at Ignite
articles.source: Axios and Microsoft, via The Neuron
articles.summary: Seven new in-house models and Agent 365 updates headline the event.

articles.headline: Anthropic IPO reportedly set to price this week
articles.source: Semafor, via The Neuron and Tech Trends News Update
articles.summary: Reports say demand is strong and the price target was raised.

articles.headline: AI helps find serious flaw in Java platform
articles.source: New York Times, via The Neuron and Tech Trends News Update
articles.summary: A security firm used AI to find a critical bug; it was reportedly patched fast.

articles.headline: HHS finalizes HIPAA update on patient record access
articles.summary: Providers get 15 days, not 30, to answer patient records requests.

articles.headline: US loses measles elimination status
articles.summary: A regional health panel says the US no longer meets the standard.

articles.headline: S&P 500 falls a fifth straight day
articles.summary: Wall Street's longest losing streak since June continued on Wednesday.

articles.headline: Fish and Game commissioner to plead guilty in poaching case
articles.summary: Brody Harshbarger will admit two misdemeanors; sentencing is Dec. 9.

articles.headline: Nampa approves new food truck rules
articles.summary: Council votes 4-1 to extend hours and allow overnight parking.

articles.headline: Ada County plans $3M landfill pond to cut hauling costs
articles.summary: A third leachate pond would keep contaminated liquid from groundwater.

briefing: The US and Iran traded strikes across the Gulf, with drones reported near bases in Kuwait and Bahrain. Mary Peltola won Alaska's Senate race, and Xi greeted Trump at the APEC summit. OpenAI released GPT-6.2, and Anthropic's IPO is reportedly set to price this week. HHS finalized a HIPAA records rule, and the US lost measles elimination status. In Idaho, a Fish and Game commissioner will plead guilty in a poaching case.
